patthana3.12:1.1: kilesaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no kileso kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.12:2.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.12:4.1: kilesaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.12:5.1: no kilesaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no kileso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.12:6.1: kilesaṃ akusalañca no kilesaṃ akusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.12:7.1: hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava, sabbattha nava, avigate nava,
patthana3.12:8.1: kilesaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso akusalo dhammo uppajjati na hetupaccayā, vicikicchaṃ paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato moho, uddhaccaṃ paṭicca uddhaccasahagato mohā,
patthana3.12:9.1: no kilesaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso akusalo dhammo uppajjati na hetu,-. vicikicchāsahagate uddhaccasahagate khandhe paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato moho, uddhaccasahagato moho,
patthana3.12:10.1: kilesaṃ akusalañca no kilesaṃ akusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. vicikicchāsahagate khandhe ca vicikicchañca paṭicca vicikicchāsahagato moho, uddhaccasahagate khandhe ca uddhaccañca paṭicca uddhaccasahagato moho,
patthana3.12:11.1: na hetuyā tīṇi. na adhipatiyā nava, na purejāte nava, na pacchājāte nava, na āsevane nava, na kamme tīṇi, na vipāke nava, na vippayutte nava, (sahajātavārādi vitthāretabbo).
patthana3.12:12.1: kileso akusalo dhammo kilesassa akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana3.12:13.1: hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā nava, majjhe tīṇi. sahajātādhipati anantare nava, samanantare nava, …pe… upanissaye nava, āsevane nava, kamme tīṇi, āhāre tīṇi, indriye tīṇi, jhāne tīṇi, magge nava, sampayutte nava,
patthana3.12:14.1: no kilesaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no kileso abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.12:15.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.12:16.1: sahajātavāre pi pañhāvāre pi sabbattha ekaṃ. saṃkilesikaṃ
patthana3.12:17.1: kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saṃkilesiko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.12:18.1: asaṃkilesikaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkilesiko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.12:19.1: hetuyā dve, ārammaṇe dve, avigate dve, lokiya lokuttara kusala sadisaṃ. (sahajātavāraṃ pi pañhāvāraṃ pi vitthāretabbā).
patthana3.12:20.1: saṃkilesikaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saṃkilesiko akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.12:21.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.12:23.1: saṃkilesikaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saṃkilesiko abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana3.12:24.1: asaṃkilesikaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkilesiko abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.12:25.1: saṃkilesikaṃ abyākatañca asaṃkilesikaṃ abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca saṃkilesiko abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.12:26.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve, avigate pañca, (lokiya lokuttara abyākata sadisaṃ. sahajātavārepi pañhāvārepi sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ). asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ
patthana3.12:27.1: kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭho kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.12:28.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.12:30.1: saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saṃkiliṭṭho akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.12:31.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.12:33.1: asaṃkiliṭṭhaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca asaṃkiliṭṭho abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.12:34.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.12:36.1: kilesavippayuttaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kilesavippayutto kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā,
patthana3.12:37.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.12:39.1: kilesasampayuttaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kilesasampayutto akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā,
patthana3.12:40.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.12:42.1: kilesa vippayuttaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kilesavippayutto abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.12:43.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ.
patthana3.12:45.1: no ca kilesaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saṃkilesiko ceva no ca kileso kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā,
patthana3.12:46.1: hetuyā ekaṃ. ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.12:48.1: kilesaṃ ceva saṃkilesikaṃ ca akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso ceva saṃkilesiko ca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.12:49.1: saṃkilesikaṃ ceva no ca kilesaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saṃkilesiko ceva no ca kileso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.12:50.1: kilesaṃ ceva saṃkilesikaṃ ca akusalaṃ ca saṃkilesikaṃ ceva no ca kilesaṃ akusalaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso ceva saṃkilesiko ca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.12:51.1: hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava, avigate nava, kilesa akusala sadisaṃ. (sahajātavārepi pañhāvārepi sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ).
patthana3.12:52.1: saṃkilesikañceva no ca kilesaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saṃkilesiko ceva no ca kileso abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.12:53.1: hetuyā ekaṃ, ārammaṇe ekaṃ, avigate ekaṃ,
patthana3.12:55.1: ca akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso ceva saṃkiliṭṭho ca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.12:56.1: saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ ceva no ca kilesaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saṃkiliṭṭho ceva no ca kileso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.12:57.1: kilesañceva saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ ca akusalaṃ ca saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ ceva no ca kilesaṃ akusalaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso ceva saṃkiliṭṭho ca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.12:58.1: hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava, avigate nava, (kilesa akusalasadisaṃ sahajātavāraṃpi pañhāvāraṃpi sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ). kilesaṃ ceva
patthana3.12:59.1: ca akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso ceva kilesasampayutto ca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.12:60.1: kilesasampayuttañceva no ca kilesaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kilesasampayutto ceva no ca kileso akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.12:61.1: kilesaṃ ceva kilesasampayuttaṃ ca akusalaṃ ca kilesa sampayuttañceva no ca kilesaṃ akusalaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca kileso ceva kilesa sampayutto ca akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.12:62.1: hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava. avigate nava, (kilesa akusala sadisaṃ sahajātavārepi pañhāvārepi sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ).
patthana3.12:63.1: kilesa vippayuttaṃ saṃkilesikaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kilesavippayutto saṃkilesiko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.12:64.1: kilesavippayuttaṃ asaṃkilesikaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kilesa vippayutto asaṃkilesiko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.12:65.1: hetuyā dve, ārammaṇe dve, avigate dve, (lokiya lokuttara kusala sadisaṃ. sahajātavārepi pañhāvārepi vitthāretabbaṃ).
patthana3.12:66.1: kilesavippayuttaṃ saṃkilesikaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kilesavippayutto saṃkilesiko abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā,
patthana3.12:67.1: kilesavippayuttaṃ asaṃkilesikaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca kilesavippayutto asaṃkilesiko abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana3.12:68.1: kilesavippayuttaṃ saṃkilesikaṃ abyākatañca kilesavippayuttaṃ asaṃkilesikaṃ abyākatañca dhammaṃ paṭicca kilesa vippayutto saṃkilesiko abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā,
patthana3.12:69.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve, avigate pañca, lokiya lokuttara abyākata sadisaṃ. (sahajātavārepi pañhāvārepi sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ).
